[RAVE] aww yeah, adults only vacation
I LOVE Disney World. My family went there basically every year, if not every other. We havnt been since 2012 or so, unfortunately. But we always talk about going again. Well, in October were decieded that my brother (21), my mom (55), my boyfriend (20), and I (18) are going indefinitely.   We normally stay at Shades of Green, a Disney resort for military familys. This time however were going to downtown Disney (I think thats the name). Its geared more towards adults, after park hours bars and nightlife.   My mom brought up today that she wants to invite my aunt (50s or early 60s). My aunt is the textbook grandma, she looooves her grandbabies. They're fucking annoying spoiled brats though, my aunt pays for anything they want. Including they built a house for them on my aunts property.   Obviously I dont want them either. My boyfriend and I dont like kids, and my brother wants to get drunk after hour partying. Right as we were about to say no, because the kids would just *have to go*! She says that this is an *adult only* vacation and that shes inviting my aunt, not any of the little brats.  Man im so excited, my aunt is like a teenager when shes not around the kids. My moms already talking about getting drunk at the around the world exhibit.  I love my mom, shes starting to accept the CF in me :)
